title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearl-shelled sea snail the size of a teacup, it glides in slow spirals through a tank of moonlit teal water, trailing a thread of glowing plankton like a ballroom ribbon. Every few turns it pauses beside a tiny drowned lantern and exhales a soft chime of bubbles, as if humming along to a waltz only the kelp can hear.
